text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant… Whew!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Just thirty more addresses to go! If I can get all these flyers delivered before sunrise…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll hit a new personal record!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series—every Umamusume dreams of competing in it someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's an intense, hair-raising series of clashes where racers hurtle with all their might toward the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some strive for glory, while others simply wish to realize their long-held dreams. But all of them have their eyes trained in on the victor's throne.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, one more runner is about to put everything on the line and join the fray.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (…This is my wish—what I want for my future!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… If I can finish up my last thirty deliveries within thirty minutes…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Then I can make my debut in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Boss!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Part-Time Worker No. 7, Ines, reporting for duty!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Morning, Ines. Look at you, so lively this early in the morning. Could you take the trash out? Thaaanks.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ack. Boss, you sure have a unique way of treating your employees! But don't worry, you can make it up to me by upping my pay next month!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Not happening. Wait, are you sure I should put you on the schedule next month? Didn't you get into that thing?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep, that's right! At long last…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm going to make my debut in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the day Ines Fujin starts training for the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I check over the regimen I made last night. It looks like we'll be fine equipment-wise. Glancing down at my wristwatch…
choice_data_list: …Only ten more minutes until morning practice, huh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day Ines Fujin learned that her debut was set, she actually came to me with a request.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I want to keep working part-time, even after my debut!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I won't cause you any trouble! And I definitely, definitely won't let my shifts mess up my punctuality!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's an incredibly meticulous Umamusume. I can't imagine she'd show up late for practice. That said…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, Oguri! You were sooo cool during your races last year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having finished their warm-ups, Umamusume start flooding onto the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The star racer, Oguri Cap, receives the brunt of the attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her feats have greatly contributed to the popularity of racing. And the next Umamusume expected to take up her mantle are…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew… Ryan. You performed spectacularly during those last 400 meters. I thought you had me beaten for sure this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right back at you, McQueen! The way you refuse to back off an inch until the race's over makes you a real tough opponent!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their names are Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan. They're both contenders from the Mejiro family, and also happen to be peers of Ines Fujin's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even ahead of their debuts, these two are already firmly in the spotlight. If they're going to become our future rivals, then we can't afford to waste a single second of training.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heya-hey, Trainer! See? I'm right on time! Ready when you are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's training includes a strength-building workout and two ramp runs. For a pre-debut Umamusume, it's pretty strenuous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it's not just those two Umamusume from the Mejiro family she'll have to contend with—she's also a late transfer who only joined Tracen from the senior division.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Truthfully, she's lacking in both muscle strength and racing instincts—two factors crucial to her success. And that's exactly why…
choice_data_list: It's time to knuckle down! Hard!
It's time to knuckle down! Hard!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin manages to make it through the regimen I prepared.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Phew! Huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha. I mean, when I get the chance to run… it only makes sense to go full throttle, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's been my dream to race since I was a kid, and now that world's within reach.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've never been this happy in my life!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt… Bzzzt…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Agh, that's my phone! Sorry, just… give me a sec!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hello? Oh, Cassie! Polly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Have your presents arrived? Oh, great! How are your new shoes?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha. Well, that's what happens when you work hard! Don't forget, your big sis is cheering you on every single day! Okay, yep. Keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha, that was Cassie and Polly. Geez, they didn't have to call me just to say thanks.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wait, you guys haven't met? Cassie and Polly are my little sisters. They're twins!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: They both take dance lessons, and they're so good they got praised by their teacher! Apparently, they're synchronized little maestros!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Basically, I used my part-time work money to buy them both some shoes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I mean, their old ones were pretty worn-out and close to falling apart.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And you know, when I said I wanted to run, my family got behind me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So if my sisters have dreams of their own, I want to be there to help too!
choice_data_list: So that's why you want to keep working.
So that's why you want to keep working.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.
choice_data_list: Even if it puts you at a disadvantage schedule-wise?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …I know it sounds naive. It's a lot to work part-time while competing. And I do need the practice—more than any other runner.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I get it. I really do. But…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha, I wasn't expecting that. Don't you want to give it a bit more time before you give me your answer?
choice_data_list: If it matters to you, it matters to me, too.
If it matters to you, it matters to me, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Ooh, really? So you'd be willing to support me in anything?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, you can't take that promise back, okay? Hehe. ♪ Hmm, I wonder what else I could say matters to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Hastily-made promises aside, this leaves me with a lot to think about when it comes to Ines's training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ponder the best way to help her achieve the growth she needs. If we're going to make the most of the limited time we have, I'd better completely revise our regimen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Morning, Trainer! Another day, another session—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wait, what happened to you?! Your dark circles have dark circles!
choice_data_list: I was working on our training schedule…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One long night of writing later, I have a revamped regimen ready to show her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right, let's see what's what. First up is stretches, a jog, and ladder drills. After that we've got weight lifting, stair climbing, and race-start practice, and then we get out the mini hurdles…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …I'm pretty confident about my stamina, but this is way too much for me to do in a single day.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pffft, haha. You know, after what you said yesterday, I thought you were a bit more on top of things.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But still, I appreciate the sheer amount of time you put into this! You get an A for effort!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So, what should we start off with? We can't get through it all, but let's do as much as we can!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Knowing you, Trainer, everything on that regimen is worth doing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Ines Fujin taking on my overstuffed schedule to the best of her ability, our training journey begins!
